_about: How cracks LOOK (F36, Muzzy 2026-10-18 'Cracks you can read'). Looks only: nothing here changes a rule. Sizes are in cells (1 = one grid cell), times in seconds. Bubbles: an open crack leaks an unsteady stream of air bubbles into the tank; a covered one leaks half as much, up through the goop; a sealed one none. X-ray: a crack with goop on it stays visible — a dotted white box round it (the visor auto-targeting) and the goop inside the box goes see-through; it goes when the crack is sealed. Sealed: where a crack was sealed, a dark grey mended scar stays (no crack ever forms there again — that part is the engine's rule).

_help.bubbles.perSec: Bubbles per second from each open crack, on average.
_help.bubbles.gust: How unsteady the stream is: 0 = an even trickle, 1 = it comes in gusts and lulls.
_help.bubbles.sizeJitter: How much sizes vary (0 = all the same, 1 = from tiny to double).
_help.bubbles.speed: How fast bubbles rise (cells per second).
_help.bubbles.wobble: How far bubbles sway side to side as they rise (cells).
_help.bubbles.wobbleHz: How fast they sway (sways per second).
_help.bubbles.lifeSec: How long a bubble lasts before it fades out (seconds). Bubbles also pop when they reach goop.
_help.bubbles.alpha: How visible the bubbles are (0 = invisible, 1 = solid).
_help.bubbles.calm: With 'reduce motion' on in Settings: the stream is this much of the normal amount, slower and without sway.
_help.bubbles.max: Most bubbles on screen at once (keeps phones fast).
_help.xray.alpha: How bright the x-ray box is.
_help.xray.dash: Length of each dash of the dotted line (cells).
_help.xray.pad: How far the box sits outside the crack's cell (cells).
_help.xray.dashSpeed: The dots march round the box this fast (cells per second; 0 = still). Stops with 'reduce motion'.
_help.xray.pulse: How much the box breathes with the crack's glow (0 = steady).
_help.xray.gooAlpha: The goop inside the box: how solid it stays (1 = not see-through at all, 0 = invisible).
_help.sealed.stitchColor: The mending stitches across the scar.
_help.sealed.stitches: How many stitches cross the scar (0 = none).
_help.xray.tint: Inside the box: a faint visor-screen tint, this colour.
_help.xray.tintAlpha: How strong the tint is (0 = none).
_help.xray.scanGap: Scan lines inside the box: the space between lines (cells).
_help.xray.scanAlpha: How visible the scan lines are (0 = none).
_help.xray.scanSpeed: How fast the scan lines roll down (cells per second; 0 = still). Stops with reduce motion.
_help.xray.wrongColor: The pixel X on a crack covered by the WRONG colour (it will not seal).
_help.xray.wrongAlpha: How visible the pixel X is (0 = no X).
_help.xray.wrongPixels: How many chunky pixels make each stroke of the X (fewer = blockier).
_help.xray.wrongSize: How big the X is (1 = a whole cell).
_help.xray.wrongOutline: A dark rim round the X pixels, so it still reads over a red crack.
_help.bubbles.covered: A crack with goop on it leaks this share of the open stream (0.5 = half); its bubbles rise up through the goop. Sealed cracks never leak.
